name: Balsamic Vinaigrette
siboNotes: Simple balsamic vinaigrette made with olive oil and balsamic vinegar is well-tolerated. Avoid commercial versions with garlic or onion powder.
preparationTips: Make homemade with balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper
Check commercial versions for garlic and onion ingredients
Add fresh herbs like basil or oregano for extra flavor
Use aged balsamic vinegar for richer taste without added sugars
nutritionalHighlights: Heart-healthy monounsaturated fats from olive oil
Low in calories when used in moderation
May help with blood sugar regulation
